purpose: 한글 가독성·화면 재배치·확대·입력·조작 품질의 출시 조건과 검증 증거를 관리한다.
scope: 기준 구현과 이 규격을 적용한 각 앱은 별도로 검증한다. 이 파일은 전체 WCAG 준수나 접근성 인증을 선언하지 않는다.

bundledFallback.scope: SUIT 비교 선택 모드에만 적용한다. SUIT cmap에 없는 U+AC00–U+D7A3 범위의 완성형 한글 8,504자 및 em dash U+2014를 번들 Pretendard로 대체한다.

coverage.matrixRule: 모든 조합을 실행했다고 추정하지 않는다. 실행한 화면·상태·서체·테마·밀도·치수·배율 조합을 증거에 나열하고, 적용 대상 중 실행하지 않은 조건은 pending으로 남긴다.
noEquivalenceClaims: Root font-size 200% is not evidence of actual browser zoom.
Viewport resizing is not evidence of actual Windows display scaling.
deviceScaleFactor or screenshot resolution is not evidence of Windows DPI testing.

fixtures.normalizationPolicy: 표시·검색에서 정규화 차이를 처리한다. 원본 경로와 저장 값은 제품이 명시한 정책 없이 변경하지 않는다.

nfdShapingVerification.rule: Raw cmap에 NFD 자모의 직접 매핑이 없다는 사실만으로 렌더링 불가를 단정하지 않는다. 실제 shaping·조합·표시 결과를 별도로 확인한다.

requirements: record the character range and rendered font

allowedExceptions.appliesOnlyWhen: SUIT Variable 2.0.5 comparison mode is selected

scope.selectionRule: Only code points absent from the bundled SUIT cmap within this range

requirements: Use the bundled Pretendard family for the declared missing characters.
Inspect the actual rendered font, mixed-font strokes, baseline, line height and wrapping.
Do not extend this exception to the default primary family or undocumented fallback ranges.
Font loading and cmap coverage alone cannot pass the rendering gate.
full text available by keyboard and pointer
no essential action or error instruction hidden

criteria: Require all 11,172 modern precomposed Hangul syllables U+AC00–U+D7A3 in the single default primary family Pretendard Variable 1.3.9.
Inspect actual Hangul rendered fonts for the default Pretendard mode and SUIT comparison mode at weights 400, 500 and 600.
In SUIT comparison mode, verify the declared bundled Pretendard fallback for 8,504 missing Hangul syllables and U+2014; runtime verification remains pending until evidence is recorded.
Review mixed-script samples for legibility, stroke density, clipping and baseline alignment.
Do not infer NFD rendering failure from absent raw cmap entries; verify shaping and display separately.
Font file presence or document.fonts.check alone cannot pass this gate.
Run listed viewports including 320 CSSpx width and 360 CSSpx height overlays.
Count unintended clipping, overlaps, page overflow and unreachable actions against zero thresholds.
Inspect nested clipping ancestors and overlays; document.scrollWidth alone is insufficient.
overflow:hidden may not conceal an unresolved layout failure.
At 200% text size, preserve information and core operations including fields, errors and dialogs.
Do not reduce text size to make the enlarged layout pass.
Record the mechanism used to resize text separately from browser zoom and OS display scale.
Apply relevant spacing properties together without otherwise changing the authored design.
No loss of content or functionality under the spacing override.
These override values do not replace the typography baseline.
Run the actual browser zoom at 100%, 125%, 150% and 200%.
Record the applied zoom and resulting CSS viewport for each run.
Preserve core operations and avoid obscured focus or controls.
Run at actual Windows display scales 100%, 125%, 150% and 200%.
Record OS, monitor, resolution, scale and application runtime.
Check native window chrome, text, popups, pointer alignment and control boundaries.
Exercise 80-character Hangul titles, 200-character unbroken paths and multiline errors in lists, inspectors, tables, dialogs and toasts.
Essential text remains readable or explicitly revealable by keyboard and pointer.
Bottom actions remain reachable as content height grows.
Complete composition, confirmation, backspace and replacement using a real Korean IME.
Enter during composition must not execute an application command.
Paste, search, save and reopen NFC and NFD samples without text, selection or cursor corruption.
Preserve original paths and stored values unless a documented product normalization policy applies.
Complete core actions using Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Escape.
Keep focused targets and focus indicators visible around fixed elements and overlays.
Verify modal focus containment, dismissal and restoration at low height and enlarged text.
A DOM element being present does not prove reachability.

evidenceRequirements.inapplicableFieldRule: 검사에 적용되지 않는 환경 필드는 null과 사유를 기록한다. 모르는 값을 통과 조건으로 추정하지 않는다.
evidenceRequirements.requiredGateNotApplicableRule: 필수 게이트를 임의로 제외하지 않는다. 지원 플랫폼이나 제품 범위 때문에 제외할 경우 사유와 승인된 범위 변경을 기록하고 별도 규격 버전을 만든다.

assessment.note: 1.1 규격과 확인 절차를 작성한 상태다. 이 개정의 GUI 실행·직접 시각 검수·실제 배율·IME 검증을 수행한 기록은 없다.
assessment.releasePassRule: Every required gate is passed with execution evidence for the current version, required visual/manual reviews are complete, and all zero thresholds are met. Static validation alone cannot set releasePassed to true.

sources.title: SUIT 공식 소개 — 한글 구성 범위
sources.supports: SUIT의 한글 구성은 완성형 2,350자와 추가 318자로 총 2,668자다. 이 출처는 em dash 포함 여부나 실제 런타임 폴백 검증을 대신하지 않는다.

sources.title: W3C Understanding WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow
sources.supports: 320 CSSpx equivalent width for vertically scrolling content; necessary two-dimensional layout exceptions.

sources.title: W3C Understanding WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text
sources.supports: Text enlargement up to 200% without loss of content or functionality.

sources.title: W3C Understanding WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing
sources.supports: Adaptation to user spacing overrides; these are not mandated default design values.
